summary: Recorded the leader-side branch that answers VerifyLeader, which the verify account relies on but no entry stated: one channel carries both a freshly dispatched request and the notification that acknowledgements are complete, so the loop dispatches on a quorum size of zero, answers success once the collected votes reach the quorum, and otherwise treats the request as evidence of a new leader - stepping itself down to follower, clearing the request from every replication stream and answering ErrNotLeader. Added the source anchor (raft.go 846-870) and a behavior entry with its conditions and the verify anchors already in the record. Validation returned valid with those two effects and no execution requested; the store-failure account's live-leader walk, vote claim and restart consequence remain as recorded.
